interpretation.label: d1_d2_split_order_changing_straddle_conditioned

preconditions.name: n_d1d2_active_pooled
preconditions.description: pooled count of fresh, d1d2-active E3 selections across all seeds
preconditions.control: use_d1_d2_population_split=True + loop_segregation reaching every fresh tick

preconditions.name: straddle_frac_mean_nonvacuous
preconditions.description: MECH-464's OWN MANDATORY non-vacuity gate: mean straddle fraction (max of assoc/limbic) across d1d2-active ticks. If ~0, no candidate pair straddles zero and the run cannot answer the reordering question -- self-route precondition_unmet, never a null
preconditions.control: candidates whose loop accumulators genuinely straddle zero (measured live probe, 2026-09-10: up to 0.53 on a single seed)

preconditions.name: da_target_clears_floor
preconditions.description: design-time |da| clears MECH-464's own |da|>=0.01 precondition (da is a pre-registered constant here, not measured per-tick, since it is fixed by the exogenous injection, not endogenously computed)

preconditions.name: fresh_select_count_sufficient
preconditions.description: pooled genuine (non-latched) E3 selections -- the fresh_select repair denominator, guards against the 785-class ~9x pseudo-replication defect (not applicable here since GateDVRecorder fresh-gates by construction, but reported as a sample-size floor)

preconditions.name: tercile_bands_scorable
preconditions.description: at least 2 of 3 straddle terciles (among straddle>0 ticks) have enough n to report a rate -- guards the diagnostic tercile profile against being computed from near-empty bands

preconditions.name: straddle_zero_bucket_scorable
preconditions.description: the straddle==0 bucket C2 compares AGAINST needs enough n for its near-zero reorder rate to be a real confirmation rather than sampling noise -- MIRRORS tercile_bands_scorable's floor on the straddle>0 side, applied to the straddle==0 side C2 actually reads

interpretation.design_note: Single condition (no da==0 control arm): the da=0 shadow argmin (loop_d1_d2_reorder_vs_da0) is computed WITHIN every tick against the SAME pre-split accumulators, so 'above the da==0 baseline' from the claim's what_would_answer holds by construction for any nonzero-da run. The substantive test is confinement (C2) and gradation (C3) against the measured straddle fraction, pooled across all seeds.
interpretation.d2_gain_zero_note: d2_gain_zero_frac=0.0000 at the chosen d1_da_gain=2.0/d2_da_gain=1.2/da=0.6 (design-time: d2_gain=max(0, 1-d2_da_gain*da) computed to stay just above 0 -- see the module-level assert). Ticks in this state have the No-Go population fully silenced, a distinct real effect MECH-464's own notes say must be excluded from being read as reordering; C3 is reported both including and excluding these ticks.
interpretation.scope_note: Tests MECH-464 only. Does not reopen MECH-463 (whose harm-urgency-threshold falsifier stands per that claim's own notes) and does not speak to the softmax-temperature arousal route (MECH-087, already evidenced by V3-EXQ-674).
